about: Findings the image scan accepts (#785, #779 answer 2). tools/image_scan.py reads this file and its docstring holds the rules: each entry is {"id": the finding's id, "package": the package it is in, "issue": the number of the issue that tracks it, "accepted": the day it was accepted, "expires": at most 30 days later, "reason": why it can wait}. An accepted finding passes through its expiry day and fails the scan from the day after.
